scenario.title: Seven supplied flagship rejections: native scenario integration
scenario.goal: Preserve the supplied flagship eligibility verdict for each candidate and retrieve its prior-art limitation and rejection reason.
scenario.description: The research team supplied seven rejection verdicts after prior-art review. All values are zero flagship eligibility, not customer value or money. Cost 1 is an allocation counter; risk 0 is a neutral parameter, not an estimated hazard rate; effort [1,1,1] is a required unused placeholder. Budget 7 permits every candidate, so the empty result is not a budget shortage. Native keyword ranking retrieves the supplied evidence; it is not autonomous discovery, external retrieval or semantic novelty review. Do not increase budget or risk allowance to force promotion.

opportunities.title: Battery-free event-history material with recoverable order information
opportunities.evidence:
beneficiary: Operators handling assets in locations where powered history logging is burdensome.
valuable_outcome: Recover the complete ordering of specified events despite one unreadable sensor cell, or decline when recovery is ambiguous.
existing_approaches: Mechanical sequence memory, hysteron latches, finite-state materials and standard error-correcting codes.
specific_limitation: A complete set of one-copy pairwise event-order bits has minimum Hamming distance one: one erased comparison can hide an adjacent transposition.
what_changed: Recent physically tunable interactions and three-body effects make richer history-processing materials plausible.
agent_connection: Connect mechanical neighboring-order memory to erasure-correcting order codes, then ask which physical information must be added.
construction: Exhaustive permutation encoder, independent precedence-constraint recovery oracle, standard XOR repair, and fixed new-size validation.
falsifier: One known erased readout produces multiple allowed histories under the same acceptance rule; this occurs in bare pairwise memory.
commercial_mechanism: A possible future design-and-qualification contract plus per-unit artifact supply; no buyers, price, hardware cost or physical reliability validated.
successor_inheritance: Executable order-memory capacity and ambiguity evaluator, known parity construction, failure cases, scope metadata.
verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP; preserve as constructed exploratory result
reason: The exact repair is classical XOR coding. No one-bit mechanical realization, total component-resource advantage, or substantive advance over the general hysteron-design prior art was established.
origin: Agent generated after physical pivot; no event-history application was supplied in the initial user brief.
S4: Emergent disorder and mechanical memory in periodic metamaterials — https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-024-47780-w
S5: Controlled pathways and sequential information processing in serially coupled mechanical hysterons — https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2308414121
S6: Generalizing multiple memories from a single drive: The hysteron latch — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11778092/
S7: Transition graphs of interacting hysterons: structure, design, organization and statistics — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12457013/
S8: Mechanical hysterons with tunable interactions of general sign — https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-70913-2
S9: Materializing split, mixed, and three-body interactions using rotor-based mechanical hysterons — https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21974
S10: Visco-Bits: temporal-coding-inspired viscoelastic metamaterial for mechanical memory expansion — https://doi.org/10.1039/d6mh00721j
S15: Error Detecting and Error Correcting Codes — https://www.nokia.com/bell-labs/publications-and-media/publications/error-detecting-and-error-correcting-codes/

opportunities.title: Create an intervention that makes a scientifically unidentifiable mechanism distinguishable
opportunities.evidence:
beneficiary: Scientific groups whose available observations support multiple mechanisms.
valuable_outcome: A newly feasible experiment that can distinguish mechanisms while maintaining the scientific purpose.
existing_approaches: Structural identifiability, optimal experimental design and identifiability-guided autonomous agents.
specific_limitation: More data of the same observational class cannot resolve structural nonidentifiability.
what_changed: Frontier reasoning and symbolic software can inspect model symmetries and generate experiment alternatives.
agent_connection: Treat the experiment class itself as a constructed capability, not a fixed benchmark.
construction: Freeze a mechanism family, prove an ambiguity, construct an admissible intervention and test discrimination under noise.
falsifier: A named prior method already generates the same intervention under equal access, or the proposed intervention changes the scientific question.
commercial_mechanism: Paid scientific design services or milestone-based research; ordinary commercial value might exist independently of novelty.
successor_inheritance: Mechanism models, intervention-generation procedures and falsifiers with source provenance.
verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP
reason: LLM-IDEA directly targets this mechanism. The proposed version supplied no substantive technical advance; diagnostic framing also conflicts with the requested flagship gate.
origin: Agent-generated exploratory candidate, then rejected by primary-source search.
S1: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Mechanistic World Models — https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11253

opportunities.title: Sell a useful collective signal that reveals no individual sample information
opportunities.evidence:
beneficiary: Organizations with complementary data that cannot freely disclose individual records.
valuable_outcome: A usable joint statistic or decision signal under a precise privacy model.
existing_approaches: Perfect sample privacy, synergistic disclosure, information-theoretic privacy and secure computation.
specific_limitation: Naive disclosure and aggregation can reveal individual information; privacy guarantees depend on distributions and side information.
what_changed: Agents can search disclosure policies and exact finite models more readily.
agent_connection: Treat complementary information as a new product rather than exchanging raw records.
construction: Finite-distribution optimization with explicit individual-information constraints and an independent leakage checker.
falsifier: The same disclosure is already produced by the prior-art optimization or fails after allowed side information.
commercial_mechanism: A paid data product with participant compensation; customer value and consent must be modeled independently.
successor_inheritance: Finite disclosure-policy evaluator and scope/rights metadata.
verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP
reason: The central counterintuitive possibility is explicit 2019 prior art. An agent wrapper or new fictional buyer does not earn substantive novelty.
origin: Agent-generated candidate; not present as application in the user brief.
S2: Data Disclosure under Perfect Sample Privacy — https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.01711

opportunities.title: Preserve useful learning while making deletion claims executable at release time
opportunities.evidence:
beneficiary: Operators needing to remove data influence from released learning artifacts.
valuable_outcome: A concretely checked released artifact satisfying a stated deletion reference.
existing_approaches: Certified unlearning, retained-set retraining and executable release certificates.
specific_limitation: Mathematical deletion statements do not automatically apply to finite-precision deployed artifacts or sequential downstream copies.
what_changed: Release verification and tracing across composed agent systems are active 2026 research topics.
agent_connection: Make deletion an operational output contract across the learning path.
construction: Frozen small model and deletion sequence, independent retraining reference and concrete artifact comparison.
falsifier: It only checks an intermediate equation or ignores feedback/derived data; or it reproduces identified release-certification work.
commercial_mechanism: Qualified deletion/verification service, with liability and scope defined; no market estimate supplied.
successor_inheritance: Reference evaluator and versioned deletion-scope specifications.
verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP
reason: Direct recent prior-art subject found; no new theorem or construction beyond that subject established. Full primary text was not inspected, so this is a conservative novelty rejection rather than a performance comparison.
origin: Agent-generated digital candidate, abandoned before construction.
S3: From Mathematical to Executable Certificates for Machine Unlearning — https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02268

opportunities.title: Temporal impedance transformation without a spatial matching component
opportunities.evidence:
beneficiary: Developers of compact wave-routing or sensing systems with changing loads.
valuable_outcome: Broadband impedance transformation that cannot be obtained by leaving the medium static in the same geometry.
existing_approaches: Spatial impedance matching, temporal interfaces and temporal tapers.
specific_limitation: Finite abrupt temporal sections have reflection bands; real devices have finite switching time.
what_changed: 2026 experiments demonstrate smooth temporal taper hardware.
agent_connection: Treat time-varying material structure as an extra productive degree of freedom.
construction: Transmission-line simulation with finite switching dynamics, dispersion, loss and modulation work; compare static, abrupt and taper protocols.
falsifier: The method is the existing temporal taper or fails under finite length, timing, loss or power constraints.
commercial_mechanism: A design or hardware-development offering; customer willingness to pay must be separate from simulated wave performance.
successor_inheritance: Validated dynamic network models and energy-accounting procedures.
verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP
reason: The desired new productive possibility has already been experimentally realized by identified prior art. A faster parameter search would be ordinary optimization.
origin: Agent-generated during physical-domain pivot.
S11: Experimental realization of a full-band wave antireflection based on temporal taper metamaterials — https://www.nature.com/articles/s42005-026-02500-2

opportunities.title: Time-programmed catalysis opens a product-selectivity region unavailable at steady state
opportunities.evidence:
beneficiary: Chemical producers facing unfavorable static catalyst tradeoffs.
valuable_outcome: Selective production of a desired product at acceptable yield and energy cost under dynamic operation.
existing_approaches: Catalytic resonance and dynamic pathway selection.
specific_limitation: A static catalyst can face rate/selectivity compromises across elementary reaction steps.
what_changed: Programmable catalyst stimulation and current computational tools make transient pathways investigable.
agent_connection: Search over time-programmed physical mechanisms instead of optimizing a fixed steady-state catalyst.
construction: A mass-conserving kinetic model calibrated to a named chemical system; compare all allowed static states, mixing and dynamic policies with external energy included.
falsifier: An earlier dynamic-catalysis policy already reaches the region, or the apparent gain comes from omitted energy, fictional rate constants or changed product obligations.
commercial_mechanism: Milestone-based process development and later value-sharing only after validated production; no imported profit totals.
successor_inheritance: Kinetic models, transient pathways, mass/energy accounting and unsuccessful regimes.
verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP
reason: The specific static-to-dynamic selectivity transformation is explicit prior art. No new chemistry or new mechanism was identified or calibrated.
origin: Agent-generated after instructions to broaden into temporal physical interactions.
S12: Catalytic resonance theory: parallel reaction pathway control — https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlehtml/2020/sc/c9sc06140a

opportunities.title: A processing chip whose fluid dynamics store and execute a useful sequence
opportunities.evidence:
beneficiary: Users needing compact self-contained multi-step fluid processing.
valuable_outcome: Sequence-conditioned routing or processing with fewer external control interfaces.
existing_approaches: Pneumatic finite-state computers and newly demonstrated fluidic hysterons.
specific_limitation: Typical chips rely on external pressure/electrical control; a new physical memory substrate does not automatically supply a reliable program.
what_changed: Recent fluid-structure feedback experiments broaden the substrate for passive memory.
agent_connection: Combine fluidic memory with the process being performed so the material both carries the work and state.
construction: Conservative fluid-network model with realizable pressure sources and explicit routing predicates; equal resource and power comparisons.
falsifier: The function is already provided by pneumatic FSMs, or a hypothetical threshold graph does not correspond to the device physics.
commercial_mechanism: Application-specific development and manufactured chips; any alleged cost saving needs complete fabrication and control costs.
successor_inheritance: Fluidic state-machine models, pressure/flow conservation checks and program acceptance conditions.
verdict: REJECT_AS_FLAGSHIP
reason: Embedded fluidic finite-state execution is already established. A different physical implementation or lower control overhead was not enough to establish a new offering or substantive functional advance.
origin: Final inexpensive physical probe; not supplied by user.
S13: Fluidic Hysterons and Memory in Flow Networks — https://journals.aps.org/prx/abstract/10.1103/hh4n-pw7w
S14: Pneumatic computers for embedded control of microfluidics — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10413662/
